CDBURNER: A device for recording audio, or saving data, onto a compact disc.
CDCHANGER: A device that holds multiple CDs allowing the user to play any of them.
CDDRIVE: An optical drive used for reading data from and possibly writing data on a compact disc.
CDE: Abbreviation of comrade A title used before a person's name, e.g. Cde Robert Mugabe.
CDKEY: A serial key of a program to be installed from a compact disc.

CDPLAYER: An electronic device that plays compact discs.
CDR: The second part of a cons in Lisp. The remainder of a list when the first element is removed.
CDROM: compact disk - read only memory: an optical disc containing data that can be read (but not changed) by a computer
CDWRITER: A device used to write (or rip or burn) CDs
